seo.title: Tree Pruning, Removal & Vegetation Care | Victoria BC
seo.description: Tree and shrub pruning, removals, invasive plant control and clearing in Greater Victoria, with permit checks under local tree bylaws. Get a free quote.

hero.h1: Tree pruning, removal and vegetation management
hero.lede: Pruning, removals, invasive plant control and brush clearing, with a check of your municipality's tree bylaw before any cut.

audiences.title: Homeowners
audiences.body: Overgrown hedges, crowded trees or a yard taken over by ivy and blackberry, handled with the right permits checked first.

audiences.title: Stratas and property managers
audiences.body: Tree and hedge work across the complex, with clear notes for council on what is protected and what needs a permit.

audiences.title: Public, institutional and rural landowners
audiences.body: Invasive removal, trail-edge clearing and vegetation control to a written plan, with proper disposal.

includes.title: Tree and shrub pruning
includes.body: Structural and clearance pruning that keeps trees healthy. We do not top trees.

includes.title: Tree removal
includes.body: Removal of dead, damaged or unsuitable trees once any required permit is in place. See our [tree permit guide](/resources/winter-pruning-and-storm-prep/).

includes.title: Hedge reduction
includes.body: Overgrown cedar, laurel and other hedges reduced in stages, within bylaw limits.

includes.title: Invasive plant control
includes.body: English ivy, Himalayan blackberry, Scotch broom, laurel and other invasives removed and disposed of to CRD guidance.

includes.title: Brush and lot clearing
includes.body: Clearing overgrowth on rural and acreage lots while keeping protected and native trees.

includes.title: Storm cleanup
includes.body: Fallen limbs and debris cleared after winter windstorms.

process.title: Request a quote
process.body: Send photos of the trees or area on the [quote form](/quote/).

process.title: Site visit and bylaw check
process.body: We identify species and size and check whether your municipality's tree bylaw applies.

process.title: Written scope
process.body: You get the planned work, any permit that may be needed, and nesting-season timing if relevant.

process.title: Work
process.body: We work safely, protect nearby plants and structures, and clean up.

process.title: Disposal
process.body: Wood and brush are removed; invasive material goes to an approved disposal site.

items: Pruning after flowering for spring-blooming shrubs
Broom and blackberry removal before seed set
Removals once permits are in place

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to remove a tree?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Every municipality in Greater Victoria has its own rules, and protected species like Garry oak and arbutus are covered at small sizes in many places. We check before any work. See our [area pages](/areas/) for local links.

faqs.q: Will you apply for the permit?
faqs.a: We can help you prepare the information the municipality asks for. The permit decision is the municipality's.
No. Topping harms trees and is prohibited under some local bylaws.
